Run a Wargame
Executive Crisis Wargaming

Find the Decision Gaps Before the Crisis Does.

Liberty CTI places leadership teams inside realistic cyber and geopolitical crises to expose where warning, authority, information, and executive decision-making break down under pressure.

Run the Wargame How It Works

The scenario is simulated. The decisions are not.

What the Wargame Reveals

We Don't Start With Your Technology.
We Start With Your Decisions.

Warning
What did leadership know—and when?
Authority
Who could actually make the call?
Dependencies
What outside your organization changed the decision?
Intelligence
What could you have known earlier that would have changed the outcome?

The exercise reveals the intelligence requirements, warning thresholds, and decision gaps that Liberty CTI can help address.

The Liberty CTI Model

The Wargame Is the Baseline.

Wargame
→
Find the Gaps

Support the Decision

Everything Liberty CTI provides afterward is shaped by what we learn about how your organization actually makes consequential decisions.

The wargame tells us what matters.
Our intelligence helps you see it coming.

What Happens

A fast executive exercise with a practical intelligence outcome.

Before

Liberty CTI conducts brief discovery to understand the organization, sector, participants, external dependencies, and the leadership decisions the scenario should test.

During

A 90-minute, decision-driven crisis scenario is facilitated by Liberty CTI principals who have supported real decisions under pressure in national-security, cyber-intelligence, command, White House, and Pentagon environments.

After

Liberty CTI identifies gaps involving decision authority, governance, intelligence requirements, warning indicators, external dependencies, cascade risk, communications, continuity, escalation thresholds, and documentation.

The goal is not theater. The goal is to find the decision, warning, governance, and dependency gaps before a real incident exposes them.

Who Should Participate

The right room is the leadership room.

CEO COO CISO General Counsel CRO CIO Operations Government Affairs Risk Committee
Who Runs It

This Isn't Run by Someone Reading a Facilitator Guide.

Liberty CTI's exercises are personally designed and facilitated by principals with decades of real-world military, intelligence, cyber, national-security, and crisis-response experience. They have operated in environments where information was incomplete, time was short, senior leaders needed answers, and the cost of a wrong judgment was real. They understand the difference between receiving information and receiving the information that changes a decision.

The scenario may be simulated.
The judgment behind it isn't.

Get Started

Your First Crisis Shouldn't Be the First Time Your Leadership Team Makes These Decisions.

Put the team in the room. Introduce the warning. Start the clock. Find the gaps while they can still be fixed.

Wargame-to-Advisory Credit

If the organization enters a Year 1 Liberty CTI standing advisory relationship within 90 days of the exercise, the Wargame fee is credited in full toward the engagement.
